gazette_location.description_raw_en: A road, as shown coloured purple in Drawing No. CM251, commencing from the junction of King's Road with Healthy Street West runs in a north-easterly direction for a distance of approximately 100 metres to join Java Road.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道於 CM 251 號圖則上以紫色標明，由英皇道與健康西街交界處起，向東北伸展約一百米，至與渣華道連接。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: A road, as shown coloured light blue in Drawing No. CM251, commencing from its junction with Java Road near the North Point Police Station, runs in a north-easterly direction for a distance of approximately 120 metres where it turns eastwards and runs for a distance of approximately 480 metres where it terminates as a cul-de-sac.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道於 CM 251 號圖則上以淺藍色標明，由近北角警署之渣華道交界處起，向東北伸展約一百二十米，再向東伸展約四百八十米，至盡頭路止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: A road in Chai Wan, as shown coloured dark blue in Drawing No. CM251, commencing at its junction with an unnamed road (marked Road 20/8 in Drawing No. CM251) and running westwards for a distance of approximately 100 metres where it turns northwards and runs for a distance of approximately 180 metres where it turns eastwards and running for a distance of approximately 130 metres joins an unnamed road (marked Road 20/2 in Drawing No. CM251).
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道位於柴灣，於 CM 251 號圖則上以深藍色標明，由與一條未命名街道（在 CM 251 號圖則上之 20/8 街道）交界處起，向西伸展約一百米，再向北伸展約一百八十米，然後向東伸展約一百三十米，至與一條未命名街道（在 CM 251 號圖則上之 20/2 街道）連接。
